# Final superclass parameter bridge

The compiler original retains a public final typed consumer and its public,
non-final synthetic bridge. The bridge casts an interface-bound input before
calling the exact target through a literal superclass chain. Intermediate
parents retain their original non-final overrides and scoped root contract.

Source and SDK parent layouts compile every generated Java unit and compare
complete original class and method metadata, Code roles, Exceptions and exact
helper accounting. Four frozen routes run 216 fresh JVM cases twice, including
inherited final dispatch, null receivers, failed casts, full-width values,
class initialization, input identity, mutation ordering and exact failures.
Seven wrong programs must fail before recovery; original classes and compiled
callers remain frozen throughout the roundtrip.
